# Contributing to kordeon

## Requirements

- [Bun](https://bun.sh) — the pinned version is in [`.bun-version`](../.bun-version).
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) — the required major is pinned in [`.node-version`](../.node-version).

## Development setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ilbertt/kordeon
cd kordeon
bun install
bun run build
```

## Commit messages

We use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) for commit messages to the main branch. Make sure your PR title is in the correct format.
